title: Thai Chicken Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make wrap filled with flavorful Thai chicken, crunchy vegetables, and creamy sauce.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add coconut oil and swirl to coat the pan.
Add chicken to the pan and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Add Thai red curry paste to the pan and stir to combine.
Stir in fish sauce, honey, and chicken broth.
Bring to a simmer and cook until the sauce has thickened, about 2-3 minutes.
Add sliced bell peppers to the pan and cook until tender.
Warm the tortilla wrap in the microwave or in a dry skillet.
Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked chicken and sauce mixture onto the tortilla.
Top with shredded carrots, chopped cilantro, and lettuce leaves.
